cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: It should print `ab`, `abab`, `ababab`, but prints `NaN` three times. Which line is wrong?

bug.fix: JavaScript cannot multiply text, so `"ab" * i` is `NaN` (not a number). Repeat it instead: `"ab".repeat(i)`.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Isse `ab`, `abab`, `ababab` print karna chahiye, par yeh teen baar `NaN` print karta hai. Kaunsi line galat hai?
hi.fix: JavaScript text ko multiply nahi kar sakta, isliye `"ab" * i` ka result `NaN` (not a number) hai. Repeat karo: `"ab".repeat(i)`.

check.question: What does this print?
check.explanation: i is 0 and then 1, so the lines have 1 and then 2 stars.

hi.question: Yeh kya print karega?
hi.explanation: i pehle 0 aur phir 1 hai, isliye lines mein pehle 1 aur phir 2 stars hain.
